title: MMI Notation v1 query parameters
description: Machine-readable contract for the query-string parameters of MMI Notation v1 (see mmi-notation-v1.md §6-§8). Values arrive as strings because the notation is a URL query string; enums below define the recognized vocabulary. Per principle P5 (forward compatibility), unknown keys MUST be ignored by processors, hence additionalProperties is true — this schema validates the *known* vocabulary, it does not reject extensions.

mode.description: Force table rendering or card (attachment) rendering. Absent = Smart Fallback decides (spec §7).

header.description: Header mode: 'none' (default), 'first' (first row of the transformed slice), or a 1-based row number within the transformed slice (spec §6 step 4).

columns.description: Comma-separated A1 column letters to keep, e.g. 'A,C,F'. Case-insensitive (spec §6 step 2).

transpose.description: 'true' transposes rows and columns (spec §6 step 3). Any other value has no effect.

grep.description: Case-insensitive substring filter over body-row cells (spec §6 step 5). Empty result set is valid, not an error.

highlightColumn.description: Column selector for row highlighting: header name (case/whitespace-insensitive) first, else A1 column letters (spec §6, decoration).

highlightValue.description: Value compared after trim+lowercase; matching rows receive the highlight class. Without this key no highlighting occurs.

formatColumn.description: '<selector>:<format>' — render matching cells as code blocks tagged with the lowercased format (e.g. 'E:json' or 'Payload:json'). Repeatable key. Invalid specs are ignored (spec §6, decoration).

caption.description: Delivery Profile (L3): caption text attached to the embed block (spec §8.1).

id.description: Delivery Profile (L3): cross-reference anchor id for the embed block (spec §8.1).

pageBreak.description: Delivery Profile (L3): print page-break attribute. Invalid values MUST be dropped silently (safe degradation, spec §8.1).

orientation.description: Delivery Profile (L3): per-block paper orientation attribute. Invalid values MUST be dropped silently (spec §8.1).

^x-.description: Experimental namespace (spec §11). Processors MAY interpret, MUST NOT error.
